- Overestimate prices when sentiment is high (especially >0.75) — reduce forecast by 1–3% for high sentiment periods.
- Underestimate prices when sentiment is low (especially <0.3) — add 1–2% to forecast for low sentiment.
- Avoid sharp upward spikes in forecast after recent price increases — cap forecast growth at 2–3% above prior peak.
- Allow for mean reversion in 3–5 day horizons — if forecast is >10% above recent 7-day average, reduce by 5–10%.
- Correct for sentiment lag: if sentiment drops below 0.25 within 3 days, reduce forecast by 1–2% per day until sentiment recovers.
- Avoid over-optimism in 30-day forecasts — cap forecast at 10% below 30-day moving average of prior 30 days if sentiment is neutral or negative.
